Nice to meet you.

There are so many lives in this world.
And each and every one has its own way of being.

In races filled with so many brilliant Umamusume,
getting carved deep and indelible into someone's memory is no easy task.

—Even so, Aston Machan kept smiling toward the sky.
Betting on that tiny sliver of hope, thinking, "Maybe they'll catch me on camera."

Orange eyes.
Reflecting Machan now, rather than the distant sky.

To leave Machan behind among that "so many,"
Machan needs "lots and lots" too.

Ehehe, over here~.
It's me, Aston Machan~.

To be remembered by as many people as possible.
That is Aston Machan's dream.
Noticing me, Aston Machan offers an explanation.

Not just an ordinary mascot.
A world-spanning super mascot.

There was Aston Machan, waving both hands at the sky.
What on earth could she be waving to? Looking up—

To make sure Aston Machan leaves a deep, lasting imprint on many hearts,
I silently renewed my vow to give it everything I had.
Hmm, hmm. So you mean Machan, right~?

Her gaze fixed straight ahead. It looked almost like
a statement of resolve—that no amount of effort would ever be too much.
Okaaay. Machan is off, then~.

If their goal is simply capturing the whole view, even if they notice her,
there's no guarantee they'll zoom in.
My very own lens. Who are you focusing on~?

Noontime. Bringing my lunch along,
I headed up to the rooftop—

I gaze up at the sky, just like Aston Machan.
What can I do as a Trainer to make her cherished dream come true?

Fufu. That's right. Just like how
Trainer-san remembered me nice and clearly.

Action over contemplation. Devoted entirely to her wish.
Earnest and straightforward. Ready to overcome any obstacle.

Things to do, things that must be done.
Things she wants to do, and things to overcome.

Popping up everywhere, ending up in everyone's hands...
A super—no, an ultra-super mascot is what I want to be!
Machan's dream is to become a mascot.

That's why the most important thing is a trace.
A mark that won't fade away even when I'm gone.

Watching Aston Machan run,
I ponder our future training.

It's a news helicopter. A friend told me they take pictures
of Tracen Academy from way, way up high.

To keep winning and leave her mark, there will be so much to tackle.
That's just how grand Aston Machan's dream is.

Is that... a helicopter?
It looks like it just passed right over Tracen Academy.

The helicopter looks like it's swimming too. Swoosh, swoosh.
Ah, the sky really is a lot like the sea~.

Will the far, far away sky feel closer someday too?
Just like the sea that everyone eventually reaches.
Haah, haah... phew... whew...
